# Atomic Implementation Matrix

> The Awtsmoos renews the whole through exact deeds, each small vessel receiving its measure; Awtsmoos.com turns brainstorm into code, proof, documentation, and release treasure.

## Parallel lane A — state and docs reconciliation

1. Inspect whether the uncertain three-doc rewrite landed.
2. Compare docs against current lifecycle/package/browser evidence.
3. Rewrite only stale docs as whole files.
4. Add decision table, troubleshooting, performance evidence.
5. Update EVIDENCE_LEDGER, REMAINING_WORK, NEXT_ACTION.

## Parallel lane B — lifecycle/core edge cases

1. Inspect existing input/seed/request tests.
2. Add lifecycle parity tests for malformed JSON, `toJSON`, authored seed, request override.
3. Add explanation-purity execution counter test.
4. Run focused lifecycle + existing facade lanes.
5. Fix core only if a test exposes a real semantic mismatch.

## Parallel lane C — compiler/constraint/cache hardening

1. Inspect registry duplicate behavior and cache identity sources.
2. Add cache invalidation tests for compiler version/support state and solver plan changes.
3. Add environment-dependent solver bypass and compile-failure cache tests.
4. Add overlapping compiler coverage determinism test if architecture supports a stable rule.
5. Document any deliberately unspecified ordering rather than inventing it.

## Parallel lane D — demo UX/accessibility

1. Add Home/End and editable/modifier shortcut guard.
2. Add lifecycle workspace busy state and completion announcement.
3. Add local compile duration, pipeline support counts, primitive count, lightweight badge.
4. Bound public error text.
5. Keep every module <=120 lines by splitting renderers/state helpers.
6. Add tests after full source draft.

## Parallel lane E — browser/security/responsive proof

1. Re-run 390px E2E after any demo source changes.
2. Add 320px viewport proof.
3. Assert no external-origin resources.
4. Assert no exceptions/console errors/severe logs.
5. Test unknown scenario query fallback.
6. Test Home/End and editable-key guard.

## Parallel lane F — Git/release ownership

1. Refresh HEAD/origin/concurrent status.
2. Build exact mission file manifest from status/import dependencies.
3. Identify any mission dependency hidden among concurrent dirty files.
4. Inspect release scripts/authority and exact commands.
5. Do not stage until all source/test/doc/browser gates are green.
6. Stage explicit paths, inspect staged diff, verify clean integration worktree, push exact SHA, activate, public E2E.

## Completion condition

Every accepted source change has tests, docs, runtime evidence, and ownership evidence. Every deferred idea is documented as deliberately deferred rather than forgotten. GitHub and production exact-SHA proof must close before REMAINING_WORK becomes empty.
